Formal PK is blood and urine only ("from blood and urine sampling"). The record does, however, plan "time-activity curves and absorbed radiation doses in organs and tumors (based on whole-body planar imaging and SPECT/CT", which measures the radiolabelled candidate in tumour over time. The manual's examples are all tissue or CSF sampling, and no ruling covers imaging-based quantification in tumour. D31-C5 settles this: imaging dosimetry of a radioligand in tumour measures the drug itself, so yes.
